content: New gate = scripts/checks/<name>.sh plus one entry in GATES in scripts/check-all.sh; ci-parity fails if a gate script is missing or CI runs anything but check-all.sh

description: Gate scripts failed under macOS /bin/bash 3.2 (pre-commit hook may use it) because assoc arrays/mapfile are unsupported and IFS=tab collapses empty fields
resolution: Avoid bash 4 features in scripts/checks; split records on \x1f

description: Extracting a function for testability pushed files over the check:size 500-line budget
resolution: Move pure code into a new file instead of raising a budget

description: A pub use re-export used only by #[cfg(test)] characterization code warns as unused in the bin crate and fails lint
resolution: Make the submodule pub and import its full path in tests instead of re-exporting

description: #[expect(clippy::expect_used)] in cfg(test)-only code fails as unfulfilled expectation because expect_used is allowed in tests via clippy.toml
resolution: Don't add expect attributes for expect/unwrap/panic lints in test code

description: clippy float_cmp (pedantic) fails assert_eq! on f64 values in tests
resolution: Compare floats with an epsilon helper

description: clippy unchecked_duration_subtraction fails Instant - Duration even in tests
resolution: Use Instant::checked_sub

description: A module test that names crate::modules::IDS fails check:layers (modules-are-independent)
resolution: Test registration through cli help/verbs instead

content: When new core types land before any producer module, put cfg_attr(not(test), expect(dead_code)) on each item citing the first-using seed, because removing a module-level expect early brings warnings back

description: clippy cognitive_complexity (max 15) also applies to #[test] fns; long runs of assert!(matches!(..)) exceed it.
resolution: Split the test or add a small status()/helper that returns a comparable value.

description: Removing a module-level #![cfg_attr(not(test), expect(dead_code))] exposes every item the new caller does not use.
resolution: Use those items or add item-level expects citing the seed that will call them.

description: Adding a third field to a struct that has a field named after the struct (Apps.apps) trips clippy::struct_field_names.
resolution: Rename the field or #[expect(clippy::struct_field_names, reason=...)] on the struct.

description: A new root item in an existing module breaks modules::tests reload ('fresh app has no items until Started') and the item_ids prefix count.
resolution: Gate the item on the module's index being populated, and update the characterization count (call it out in the commit).

description: clippy float_cmp also fires on assert_eq! of [f32; N] arrays.
resolution: Compare element-wise with an epsilon helper in tests.

description: clippy struct_excessive_bools fails when a struct has more than 3 bool fields.
resolution: Group related flags into a small Copy struct.

description: `gen` is a reserved keyword in Rust edition 2024; it cannot be a field or variable name.
resolution: Use `epoch` (or another name) for generation counters.

description: Real platform hook closures in a module's mod.rs count against its coverage floor.
resolution: Put real hooks in <module>/wire.rs (no floor) and keep testable logic in pure files.

description: clippy struct_field_names also rejects a field that starts with the struct's own name (struct ByTask { by_task }).
resolution: Rename the struct or the field.

description: Removing one cfg_attr(not(test), expect(dead_code)) in core/control.rs can surface dead_code errors on other unused structs that item referenced.
resolution: Give each not-yet-used item its own expect; re-run lint after removing any.

description: src/config.rs is at its 500-line budget; adding another DEFAULT_CONFIG example test fails check:size, and moving in-file tests out lowers its coverage % below the floor.
resolution: Move the example tests to src/config/tests.rs together with a coverage floor review (flick seed filed).

description: In a git worktree the pre-commit hook gates the MAIN checkout, not the worktree: core.hooksPath is absolute (/Users/jayminwest/Projects/flick/scripts/hooks) and the hook cds to dirname/../.., so a green hook says nothing about worktree changes (and main-checkout flakes can block the commit).
resolution: Run scripts/check-all.sh from the worktree root yourself before committing in a worktree; don't trust the hook's result there.

description: A const fn used only to build a const table (e.g. TOPICS) shows 0 line coverage under llvm-cov, failing a 100% floor
resolution: Call the const fn once at runtime in a test

description: In a worktree the pre-commit hook gates the main checkout, not the worktree: core.hooksPath is an absolute path to the main repo's scripts/hooks and the hook cds to its own parent repo.
resolution: In a worktree run scripts/check-all.sh in the worktree before committing, or set core.hooksPath to the worktree's scripts/hooks for that commit.

description: llvm line coverage counts a line uncovered when a never-run closure sits on it, e.g. map_err with a format closure after an UPDATE that never fails; this dropped tasks/store.rs below its floor.
resolution: Bind the error mapper once as a local closure and reuse it with map_err on a path that tests do exercise.

description: Merging a worktree agent's branch silently reverted seed state: its commit carried a stale .seeds/issues.jsonl (dropped seeds created on main after it branched, reopened closed ones).
resolution: Worktree agents must not commit .seeds/ (seeds belong to main); after each merge, check 'git show <merge> --stat' for .seeds/issues.jsonl and diff seed statuses. Also: git merge skips the pre-commit hook, so run scripts/check-all.sh on main after merges.
